objective: Test whether the entire frozen R7-C0 boundary-role family remains concentrated at document/row boundaries after mechanically excluding singleton lexical domains that make header and closer identical by construction.
reason_for_audit: The same frozen source words were observed among both DOCUMENT_HEADER and DOCUMENT_CLOSER candidates, making singleton lexical documents/rows a material structural confound that must be audited before any functional-role promotion.

eligibility_correction.DOCUMENT_HEADER: evaluate only documents containing at least two lexical source-word occurrences
eligibility_correction.DOCUMENT_CLOSER: evaluate only documents containing at least two lexical source-word occurrences
eligibility_correction.ROW_HEADER: evaluate only unambiguous source rows containing at least two lexical source-word occurrences
eligibility_correction.ROW_CLOSER: evaluate only unambiguous source rows containing at least two lexical source-word occurrences
eligibility_correction.NUMERIC_BLOCK_INTRODUCER: unchanged if present in frozen family
eligibility_correction.NUMERIC_BLOCK_CLOSER: unchanged if present in frozen family

survival_gate.null: exact binomial upper tail using the corrected corpus-wide role-background probability; this p-value is a post-hoc corrective diagnostic, not independent confirmation

allowed: post-hoc singleton-boundary confound survival or failure for each frozen R7-C0 candidate
